build_language_model: build a language model with configurable RNN cell, dropout, and loss regularization
count_model_parameters: count trainable parameters of a language model from a configuration dictionary
prepare_training_feed: prepare a feed dictionary with source, target, conditioning, and dropout placeholders
run_training_step: run a single training step and return loss, summary, and last RNN state
accumulate_gradients: accumulate gradients across minibatches for gradient accumulation training
